The '''Ice Detonator''', also known as the '''Ice Spike''', was a [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]] used and popularized by the [[Fisher/Legends|fishermen]] of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. It was manufactured by the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]].

==Description==
An ovoid, fist-sized [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]], the Ice Detonator was a specialty explosive set via a timer. The bottom-heavy grenade had an eight-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] blast radius, and cost eight hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="BSoS" /> It utilized a shaped charge to blast holes through ice which was often more than a meter thick.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
The Ice Detonator was utilized by [[Fisher/Legends|fishermen]] on the [[planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]] for deep-sea [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] in areas such as the [[Bay of Fflus]] in the [[Beija Minor Sea]]. In addition to rods and reels, game fishermen used explosives to reach the exotic wildlife living beneath the [[Ocean/Legends|sea's]] thick layers of ice, including the [[guda fish]]. The fishermen drilled a half-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] hole in the ice and dropped the timed ice spike, bottom-first, into the shaft. The fishermen then rushed to clear the eight-meter blast radius, although careless off-worlders were known to catch hypothermia from dropping these devices through thin ice sheets. Fishermen were even pulled beneath the surface by the creatures they intended to catch.<ref name="BSoS" />
